title: Video
description: A video file (AVI, MP4, MOV, MKV, Motion JPEG 2000), as dev's Video stack: uint8 frames, height x width x frames, or height x width x 3 x frames with colour (red, green and blue as channels; a video whose first frame has the same red, green and blue is grayscale). Read a chunk of frames at a time, with VideoReader in MATLAB and imageio's ffmpeg in Python (the video extra). Read only.
